description: arbiter guardrails: start the daemon and register the session, block direct probe and serial access, and pass on queue notices (granted, paused, revoked). Each hook does nothing if arbiter isn't installed yet.

hooks.command: if command -v arbiter >/dev/null 2>&1; then arbiter hook session-start; else echo '{"systemMessage": "arbiter is not installed yet. Run /arbiter:setup to set it up.", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "The arbiter command is not installed, so the shared dev boards are not available yet. If the user wants to use a board, use the arbiter setup skill."}}'; fi
command -v arbiter >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; arbiter hook pre-tool-use
command -v arbiter >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; arbiter hook post-tool-use
command -v arbiter >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; arbiter hook session-end
